chunks: From him, from Imran ibn Musa, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, who said:

I was in the presence of Al-Reza (peace be upon him), so Safwan asked him about a man who married the daughter of a man, and that man had a wife and a mother of a child (from another wife). So the father of the girl died. Is it permissible for the man who married the daughter to marry his [own] wife and the mother of his child? He said: There is no problem with it.

key_terms.أَبُو الْجَارِيَةِ: The father of the girl (referring to the father of the woman one has married)
key_terms.أُمُّ وَلَدٍ: Mother of a child (a concubine or wife who bore a child to her master/husband)
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: There is no problem with it / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to marry the mother of one's wife's stepchild in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the permissibility of a man marrying both the wife and the mother of his child (Umm al-Walad) of another man, provided the father of the bride is deceased. It highlights the distinct juristic categories in Shia fiqh where the prohibition of marrying a woman and her mother does not automatically extend to marrying a woman and her husband's other wife, emphasizing the specific lineage-based restrictions in Surah An-Nisa. The ruling underscores the flexibility in polygamous arrangements when kinship ties are not direct vertical lines of descent.

en.hubeali: From him, from Imran Bin Musa, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl who said,

‘I was in the presence of Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, so Safwan asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who married a daughter of a man and for the man was a wife and a mother of the children. So the father of the girl died, is it Permissible for the man to marry his wife and a mother of his children?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with it.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ‘Imran ibn Musa from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl who has said the following: “

Once I was with al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when Safwan asked about a man who has married the daughter of a man and the man has a woman and a mother of child. The father of the girl dies; if this man can marry the wife and mother of the child of the deceased. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful.’”
